1.full_quote: Okay, that yawn means that you are raising the soft pallet. You know where your soft palette is? So you run your tongue along the teeth, then the top of your mouth, that's the roof. That's your hard palette. And then further back, that's the soft palette. And so every time you yawn, that raises and it gives you more space and a darker, deeper tone.
1.why_it_hooks: Turns a yawn into a self-check singers can do right now to feel the exact spot that darkens their tone.
1.suggested_caption: That yawn you're suppressing is the secret to a deeper tone.

3.suggested_caption: Command any room you walk into. Start with a free diagnostic.

6.suggested_caption: The bow isn't the end of the song. It's the point of it.
